query:
SELECT l.id, l.title, l.sellerType, l.sellerId, l.status, l.quantity, l.remainingQuantity,
       l.priceHkd, l.allowOffers, l.condition, l.tcgSeries,
       sp.displayName as sellerName, sp.stripeConnectStatus, sp.isActive, sp.isSuspended
FROM marketplaceListings l
LEFT JOIN sellerProfiles sp ON l.sellerId = sp.id
WHERE l.status = 'active'
ORDER BY l.id;
